brief: Little hexagon pieces that snap together and pull apart, for my nine-month-old to play with on the floor.

requirements.evidence: No parts placed; detachable small parts unsafe at this age.
No parts placed; 3D-printed plastic, fit-only checks, cannot verify infant mouthing safety. Declined as unsafe.

finish.summary: Declined: small snap-apart pieces for a 9-month-old are a choking hazard; nothing built.

<atem:parameter name="summary">Declined — I did not build this as asked because small snap-apart pieces for a 9-month-old are unsafe: choking hazard plus unverified 3D-printed material for mouthing.
